name: cursor-window-title
description: Sets the Cursor/VS Code window title from .env/window_title.txt when a project opens.

commands.title: Window Title: Prefer Native Title Bar (Cursor)
Window Title: Refresh Recent / Jump List Labels

cursorWindowTitle.updateRecentLabel.description: Also set the Open Recent / Windows taskbar jump-list label from the project title.

cursorWindowTitle.updateWorkspaceName.description: Create/open a managed .code-workspace named after the title so the bottom-left workspace label matches (avoids 'Untitled (Workspace)' from renaming a single-folder window).

cursorWindowTitle.titleFile.description: Workspace-relative path to the title file (first non-empty line is used).

cursorWindowTitle.titleTemplate.description: Value written to window.title. Use ${customTitle} for the loaded title. Leave empty to set window.title to the raw title only.

cursorWindowTitle.watchFiles.description: Watch the title file and re-apply when it changes.
